title: Work order received from Coastal Energen
excerpt: A work order from Coastal Energen, recorded in August 2010.
body: The group recorded a work order from Coastal Energen, dated August 2010.

Work associated with power infrastructure carries the constraint common to the whole energy sector: the cost of interruption is borne by everyone downstream of the asset, not by the asset alone, which shapes how the work is sequenced and handed over.

This entry is drawn from the client's own published record. The scope of the order, its duration, its present status and any associated figures have not been confirmed for publication here, and no value is stated deliberately.
_note: CLIENT-CONFIRM REQUIRED. This entry is drawn from the client's own currently published material and states only the counterparty, the month and the nature of the work. No contract value is included, deliberately. Before launch the client must confirm: that this project may still be publicised; the counterparty's permission to be named; the accurate scope and completion status; whether any figures may be stated and, if so, sourced from where; and the correct exact date, since only the month is recorded here. If any of that cannot be confirmed, remove the entry rather than softening it.
